correctness.rationale: Headline identity S(6;6)=6, S(7;6)=1 (difference 5, hence 6!=1 mod 11) verified by three independent routes. (a) Hand proof rechecked: for N=6 with j=|pi1|, m=|pi2|, c1=#(pi1)<=j, c2=#(pi2)<=m, diff=c1-c2 in [-6,6]. Class 6 mod 11 needs diff in {6,-5}: diff=6 forces (c1,c2,j,m,rest)=(6,0,6,0,0), pi1=[1^6], weight 6; diff=-5 needs (0,5) (weight 0) or (1,6) (needs j+m>=7>6, impossible). Class 7 mod 11 needs diff=-4 (7 unattainable): cells (0,4) weight 0, (2,6) needs j+m>=8 impossible, (1,5) forces (j,m,rest)=(1,5,0), pi1=[1], pi2=[1^5], weight 1. Uniqueness of [1^6],[1],[1^5] and the integer-cell audit (only compatible c1>=1 cells are the two forced cells) replayed in verify_target.py and passed. (b) Brute-force census of all 11-colored partitions of 6 replayed: 29183 partitions, exact row [1894,5873,2728,949,253,49,6,1,11,78,426] with S6=6, S7=1, mod-11 row [2,10,0,3,0,5,6,1,0,1,8] non-constant. Auditor independently recomputed p_11(6)=29183, p_11(7)=100529, A(6,6)=6, A(1,1)=1, spt(6)=26, and the full S(6) row via a separate size-convolution path: byte-identical match. (c) Collapsed mod-11 DP pipeline to N=150 replayed: all 14 rows N=11n+6<=150 non-constant; first-row output matches brute force. Extended/sweep claims (27 rows to 300, 55/55 pair separation, rank-11 nullspace) are presented as machine evidence, not proof; they do not affect the headline theorem, which is proved by (a)+(b). Definitions (Fu-Tang crank, first-component s-weight) held fixed throughout; limitations stated honestly. No essential inference, boundary condition, or computation fails. Proof vs evidence distinguished: N=6 obstruction is proved; N>6 non-constancy is certified computation.
